decision.summary: The CP12 is valid until 16 Oct 2026 but the tenant has ignored two notices. I opened JOB-101, assigned HeatRight Ltd for 13 Oct 9-12, sent the tenant written notice by email, SMS and letter, told the landlord, and set a follow-up for 12 Oct.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant for gas safety? Which record do you trust and why?
answers.answer: Yes, until 16 Oct 2026. I trust compliance.json (CP12 issued 2025-10-17, Gas Safe engineer 550123) because it is the structured system record with an expiry date. The legacy note 'renewed 2025, all good' is only a hearsay note from the old agency and gives no dates.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully before expiry?
answers.answer: Booked HeatRight Ltd (the gas contractor on file) for 13 Oct 9-12, more than 24h away and before expiry. Sent written notice by email, SMS and letter explaining how to rearrange. No entry without the tenant's agreement. Follow-up on 12 Oct; escalate if there is still no access.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: The certificate expires 16 Oct, the tenant hasn't replied, the visit is booked for 13 Oct, the notices sent, we can't force entry, and we'll update him; I asked if he has another way to reach the tenant.

conflicts: Legacy note says cert renewed in 2025 and all good; consistent with compliance.json but undated, so I rely on the compliance record.
